title: Homogeneous depth-five lower bounds for iterated matrix multiplication
summary: OpenAI 数学仓库收录的研究手稿。展开查看英文摘要，或标记后让我进一步解释。

abstractEnglish: Let $`\mathop{\mathrm{IMM}}\nolimits _{n,n}`$ be the $`(1,1)`$ entry of a product of n independent $`n\times n`$ matrices of variables. Over every field of characteristic zero, every syntactically homogeneous $`\Sigma\Pi\Sigma\Pi\Sigma`$ circuit computing $`\mathop{\mathrm{IMM}}\nolimits _{n,n}`$ has at least $`n^{\sqrt n/400}`$ gates for all sufficiently large n, with an absolute threshold independent of the field. Bottom linear forms may have arbitrary support, and arbitrary finite fan-in, fan-out, and gate sharing are allowed. Over every field, a block expansion gives such circuits with at most $`n^{\sqrt n+4}`$ gates for n ≥ 2. Thus the gate complexity over characteristic-zero fields is $`n^{\Theta(\sqrt n)}`$.
titleEn: Homogeneous depth-five lower bounds for iterated matrix multiplication
titleZh: 迭代矩阵乘法的齐次深度五下界

details.overview: 该稿件研究迭代矩阵乘法IMM_{n,n}在齐次深度五算术电路中的门复杂度。作者声称：在任意特征零域上，每个语法齐次ΣΠΣΠΣ电路计算IMM_{n,n}至少需要n^{√n/400}个门（n充分大，阈值与域无关）；底层线性形式可任意支撑，允许任意有限扇入、扇出与门共享。摘要还称在任意域上块展开给出至多n^{√n+4}个门的电路，故特征零域上门复杂度为n^{Θ(√n)}。意义在于给出接近紧的深度五下界，但尚未经独立审查。
keyPoints: 作者声称特征零域上齐次深度五电路计算IMM_{n,n}至少需n^{√n/400}个门。
下界允许底层线性形式任意支撑及任意有限扇入、扇出和门共享。
